title: Unfinalized Execution Intents Response
description: Response returned by GET /execution-intents/unfinalized: intents that never reached a signed Execution Trust Record, oldest first. Each is an action that may have been released with no signed record. Every entry needs an operator to establish what happened. Only entries in state RELEASED can be repaired with POST /execution-intents/{businessTransactionId}/finalize. There is currently no operation to close a PREPARED or ERRORED intent that was reconciled by hand, so it stays listed.
